summary: Iteration 2 e2e: Careers (CV upload), Cookie consent (Law-25), Admin Applications tab, brand rename, and regressions on contact/donations. Backend pytest grew to 25 tests (100% pass) covering all new careers endpoints incl. oversized (>5MB) rejection and invalid content-type (image/png) rejection, admin token enforcement (header + query token), cv_data not leaked in listing, and PDF download (Content-Type application/pdf). Frontend Playwright validated /carrieres form submit with PDF -> success toast in FR; cookie banner appears on first visit, hidden on 'Tout refuser', persists rejection via localStorage 'ghap_cookie_consent' (no reappear after reload); admin login with ghap2025admin shows all 3 tabs and the submitted application with a working CV download link including ?token=ghap2025admin; navbar shows 'Groupe Havre d'Amour et de Paix' brand + 'Carrières' nav link; FR<->EN toggle still functional. Donation Stripe redirect verified via backend (URL contains checkout.stripe.com).

issues: When language is toggled to EN, the hero overlay card still shows French strings ('Sécurité & accompagnement permanents'). Wire it through useLanguage()/t for consistency.
Frequency labels 'Unique'/'Mensuel' and some admin headings are still rendered in French via t.donation.* keys; verify EN translations exist or hardcoded fallback strings.

action_items: Optional: localize the hero overlay card text on Home (Sécurité & accompagnement permanents) so EN visitors see the English equivalent.
Optional: review remaining hardcoded French strings (e.g., admin frequency labels) for full EN parity.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/careers stores cv as base64 in MongoDB. For documents close to 5MB this can bloat docs (base64 = +33%). Consider GridFS or object storage if applications scale.

server.py /api/careers/{id}/cv accepts token as a query string. This leaks the admin token in browser history, server logs, and Referer headers when the PDF is opened in a new tab. Prefer X-Admin-Token header or a short-lived signed URL. Currently acceptable because admin is the only consumer but flag for hardening.

server.py reads the entire upload into memory (cv.read()) before size check. A malicious >5MB upload still buffers in RAM. Consider streaming + early abort or FastAPI's UploadFile.size when available.
server.py validates content_type from the client; a client can spoof it. For PDF/DOC magic-byte sniffing would be more robust.

Careers.jsx posts FormData with an explicit 'Content-Type: multipart/form-data' header (line 49) — this prevents axios from auto-adding the boundary. It still works because the browser overrides when a FormData body is detected, but the explicit header is unnecessary and fragile; remove it.
Admin.jsx puts admin token in href query string for CV link — same exposure concern as above.
CookieConsent.jsx uses localStorage which fails in private/Safari ITP modes; consider try/catch around get/set.
